description: This file implements a builder class for creating SMS PDU (Protocol Data Unit) messages, including encoding user data in GSM 7-bit format, validating phone numbers, and constructing the PDU string according to GSM standards.

classes.name: PDUFormatBuilder
classes.description: A class responsible for constructing SMS PDU strings with methods to set user data and sender number, and to build the final PDU string.

methods.name: SetUserData
methods.description: Sets the user data (message content) to be encoded in the PDU.

methods.name: SetSenderNumber
methods.description: Sets the sender's phone number for the PDU.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the PDU string based on the set user data and sender number, performing necessary encoding and validation.
